changelog: Amplicon PDF report rebuilt (single run, DADA2 and Emu): Method / Result / References layout like the U2BI reports, with every figure drawn in the PDF — read counts per pipeline step, read funnel, ASV length histogram, reads and n_ASV per sample, rarefaction curves, top-30 stacked bars at Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus and Species, a clustered top-30 genus heatmap, archaeal community table, alpha-diversity table and panels (Observed, Chao1, ACE, Shannon, Simpson), Bray–Curtis PCoA, UPGMA dendrogram and dissimilarity heatmap, group-mean composition when groups have replicates. Auto-written narratives (pipeline outcome, QC interpretation, composition per sample, alpha, beta), cutadapt/chopper/Emu commands in the methods, a 'Folder:' line under each figure and a reference list. Everything is computed from asv_table + taxonomy, so it works whether or not r_tables/ exists. No restart needed.

previous.changelog: PDF reports for ONT 16S (Emu) runs: 'Report build failed — No readable results' fixed. The report builder only knew the DADA2 layout (taxonomy_table.csv, one row per ASV sequence); it now reads Emu's taxonomy.csv / asv_table.csv (one row per taxon), turns Emu's relative abundances into estimated reads using each sample's classified-read count, shows Emu's read stages (input → QC → primers → non-chimeric), Emu configuration instead of truncLen/maxEE, 'taxa' instead of sequence variants, no ASV-length sections, and species without the '<Genus> sp.' placeholders. Single and comparison reports both work (e.g. emu_db_mar2026 vs emu_silva). DADA2 reports are unchanged (checked byte-for-byte on existing runs). Beta: the report dialog always lists the job it was opened from and refreshes the run list. No restart needed.
